$comment: M13. The first family a witness tells on a page: a line before it (in the same paragraph, ahead of the deck's frame) and a line after it (on the end of the telling's last paragraph). The body is the telling itself, the engine's. Holes: thing (bind thing: what the witness has in hand, off their activity card; says nothing), body. Slots: {speaker} and {speaker.he} .He .him .his .His .man .doing .act; roles {thing} and the page's {prop} (a prop the question's sheet put in the room). These lines assert no case fact at all: no hour, no place by name, nobody but the witness. Flags: family (movements, evening, knowing, counts, strangers, timing, event, thing, find, self…), temper, volunteered, thing (the witness has a thing), prop (the page has a prop), named (the deck's frame opens on the witness's name). A line after the telling must not say the witness has finished talking: a follow-up may come after it.

sheets.name: Straight
sheets.notes: The telling as the engine writes it: nothing before, nothing after.

sheets.name: Put it down
sheets.notes: The witness puts what they have in hand down to answer, and picks it up again after: a callback inside one family. Not when the deck's frame opens on their name too.

parts.text: {speaker} put {thing} down to answer, which was a courtesy.
Then {speaker} picked {thing} back up, and that was the end of the courtesy.

sheets.name: On the fingers
sheets.notes: A talker's list (their own evening, or who came and went): after it, the count has used up a hand. Goes on from the deck's frames that count on fingers, and stands alone after the rest. Talkers only, so it doesn't come round too often.

parts.text: {speaker} had used up one hand on it and was starting on the other.

sheets.name: Could have gone on
sheets.notes: Somebody who likes to talk: after the telling, the sign that there was plenty more where it came from.

parts.text: {speaker} stopped there, but only to breathe.

sheets.name: Not a word wasted
sheets.notes: Somebody guarded, who took their time: after the telling, how little of it there was.

parts.text: {speaker} didn’t waste a word of it. I’ve had chattier telegrams.

sheets.name: Enjoying it
sheets.notes: Somebody who likes to talk, the other way: after the telling, who was having the better time.

parts.text: {speaker} was enjoying this more than I was, and I was the one being paid for it.
